items.title: Gambia Immigration Department Intercepts 47 Suspected Irregular Migrants in Bakau, Tanji Operations
items.summary: By Makutu Manneh The Gambia Immigration Department (GID) says it intercepted 47 suspected irregular migrants, including three alleged smugglers and sailors, in separate operations in Bakau and Tanji on Saturday. In the first operation, conducted in Bakau on Oct. 3, personnel f...
